description: Chile's Undersecretariat of Telecommunications has collected sector statistics from operators since 2006 through an information transfer system with 16 reporting annexes, and publishes them as downloadable series. The internet section holds fixed internet connection series and mobile internet connection series from the first quarter of 2002 to June 2026, mobile data traffic from June 2017 and fixed data traffic from January 2019, each as an Excel workbook published in August 2026. Further sections give series for fixed and mobile telephony, pay television and consumer complaints, historical statistics and annual sector reports. The connection workbooks break connections down by operator, technology and region, and the traffic workbooks give data volumes by period; these breakdowns are inferred from SUBTEL's usual reporting and were not read. Coverage: Chile, national and regional. Format and access: XLSX downloads from the SUBTEL website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: operator-reported; definitions change over the long series; the workbooks were not opened, so regional and commune detail is unconfirmed. Simulation uses: long demand and traffic series for Chilean fixed and mobile network models, including traffic growth for capacity planning. Related records: the LAC-IX survey and map covers Chilean exchange points; the TeleGeography submarine cable map covers Chile's Pacific landings; the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series.
